sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Soyang Europe is a leading manufacturer and distributor of digitally printable wide-format and superwide-format media and surface coverings for sign & display, design, marketing, construction, and décor industries.

Industry: Printing & Signage Materials · HQ: Accrington, Lancashire, United Kingdom · Size: <$50M · Products: Wide-format printable media, Superwide-format media, Surface coverings, Self-adhesive vinyl, Textile materials, Banners

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Soyang Europe scores 74 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (30/30), application fit (25/25) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (32% similar on media, print, display, self-adhesive); Mactac (22% similar on media, vinyl, signage, print); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (10% similar on digitally, vinyl, signage, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
